root_cause: Scan history/claim frontend did not forward the Netlify Identity Bearer token, anonymous browser receipt was session-tab local, and verified scan ownership could be silently reassigned for non-UUID tenants.

prevention.rule: All authenticated Portal V2 scan traffic reuses portalStateClient.authHeaders and is forbidden without Bearer; only verified server receipt clears a 7-day anonymous scan token. Edge claim never reassigns verified company ownership.

architecture.identity: Netlify Identity JWT via Portal State Client
